chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Hamzah, who said:
I said to Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام, “What is the least degree of nasb?” He said, “That a man innovates something, then loves on account of it and hates on account of it.”

key_terms.فَيُحِبَّ: then he loves based on it
key_terms.يَبْتَدِعَ: to introduce an innovation not originally established
key_terms.يُبْغِضَ: and he hates based on it
key_terms.ٱلنَّصْبِ: hostility and oppositional enmity in religion

ai.seo_question: What is the least form of nasb according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith defines the lowest level of nasb as introducing an innovation and then making loyalty and enmity depend upon it. Its significance is that deviance begins when a person turns invented ideas into standards for loving and hating others.
